Tired of beige buffets?

Order for a business lunch or a private event. Cold, hot and breakfast buffets, with details and prices from the team.

BreakfastFresh breakfast bagels, rich Biscoff overnight oats and house-made nutty granola pots.
Base coldDeep-filled wraps, base club sandwiches, kettle crisps and brownie bites.
BakedPiping hot jacket potatoes, sweet or white, with house-made chilli, chicken curry, fluffy rice and more.
ExtrasPasta salads, freshly baked sausage rolls and protein balls.

Baby showers to Christmas markets: the Base Bar hosts family celebrations and corporate occasions, with the buffet catering on top.

Good to know

  • Dogs welcome. Bring your furry friends along.
  • Parking. A private car park with 20+ spaces, plus on-road parking outside.
  • Free wifi. For all customers.
  • Step-free. Disabled access to the building and facilities.
  • Licensed. A licensed restaurant serving a range of alcoholic drinks.
  • Air conditioned. Cool in the warmer months.
  • Gift vouchers. Pop in and ask the team. Gift as little or as much as you like.
  • Everyone welcome. No membership needed.
  • 5 star food hygiene rating. Most recent inspection 20 March 2024.
